cues.en: Okay, so the first analysis that I was curious about was to correlate the marriage rates and the divorce rates over time.
cues.zh: 首先，我好奇的是，結婚率與離婚率隨時間的相關。

cues.en: So we have seen that the marriage rates are generally declining over time and also that the divorce rates are generally declining over time.
cues.zh: 我們已經看到，結婚率整體隨時間下降，離婚率也整體隨時間下降。

cues.en: So I wanted to know, are those significantly correlated?
cues.zh: 因此，我想知道，兩者是否顯著相關？

cues.en: So does one state's decline in marriage rates correlate with that same state's decline in divorce rates over time?
cues.zh: 也就是某個州結婚率的下降，是否與同一個州離婚率隨時間的下降相關？

cues.en: So what I did to test that was loop through all of the states.
cues.zh: 為了檢驗，我用迴圈走過所有州。

cues.en: So 50 states plus DC, that gives us 51 in total.
cues.zh: 50 州加上特區，總共是 51。

cues.en: And then I correlated the marriage data over time with the divorce data over time from each state.
cues.zh: 接著，分別在每個州內，計算結婚資料與離婚資料跨時間的相關。

cues.en: And then I drew that as a plot.
cues.zh: 再把結果畫成圖。

cues.en: So let's see what that plot looks like.
cues.zh: 看看那張圖的樣子。

cues.en: I'm gonna run all the code in this cell and so here we see that all of these states correspond to rows here.
cues.zh: 我要執行這個程式區塊的所有程式；這裡每個州對應一列。

cues.en: And the x axis is the correlation coefficient between the marriage rates and the divorce rates over the years separately for each state.
cues.zh: X 軸是各州分別跨年份計算的，結婚率與離婚率之間的相關係數。

cues.en: And then I colored them green if they're statistically significant and red if they're not statistically significant.
cues.zh: 如果統計上顯著，就標成綠色，不顯著就標成紅色。

cues.en: Now here you can see the output of the core function.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 corr 函式的輸出。

cues.en: We get the correlation value and the P value, but this is the non corrected P value.
cues.zh: 會得到相關值與 P 值，但這是未校正的 P 值。

cues.en: So I had to add a little bit of extra code to say if this P value is smaller than our threshold P value and that threshold P value I set to be
cues.zh: 因此，我還加了一點程式，判斷這個 P 值是否小於 P 值門檻；門檻設定成

cues.en: Bonferroni corrected of 0.05 divided by 51.
cues.zh: Bonferroni 校正後的 0.05 除以 51。

cues.en: So is Bonferroni correction for all of the states plus DC.
cues.zh: 也就是對所有州加上特區，做 Bonferroni 校正。

cues.en: Now this is actually a bit conservative because these states are not randomly drawn and they are not independent of each other.
cues.zh: 這其實有點保守，因為這些州不是隨機抽取，也不是彼此獨立。

cues.en: So Alabama and Arkansas are really close to each other geographically, they're close to each other socioeconomically and culturally and so on.
cues.zh: 例如阿拉巴馬與阿肯色，地理上接近，社會經濟與文化等方面也接近。

cues.en: So it's a little bit overly conservative to say that the P value threshold is assuming that all of these states are independent of each other,
cues.zh: 因此，這個 P 值門檻假設所有州彼此獨立，

cues.en: each of these correlations is an independent test.
cues.zh: 每個相關都是獨立的檢定，這有一點過度保守。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I think it's better to be a little bit too conservative than a little bit too liberal.
cues.zh: 不過，我認為稍微太保守，比稍微太寬鬆好。

cues.en: Okay, so these states, it's not surprising that most of the states have a significant correlation between divorce rates and marriage rates.
cues.zh: 大多數州的離婚率與結婚率顯著相關，並不意外。

cues.en: That's not surprising.
cues.zh: 這不令人意外。

cues.en: You can imagine that the more people are getting married, the more people are gonna get divorced, it's kind of inevitable.
cues.zh: 你可以想像，結婚的人越多，離婚的人也越多，這幾乎無可避免。

cues.en: But it's also interesting to see that there are some states where the correlation is modest but not statistically significant.
cues.zh: 但也很有意思，有些州的相關程度中等，卻沒有統計顯著性。

cues.en: And there's other states where it's not even close.
cues.zh: 另外一些州則差得更遠。

cues.en: If anything, it's numerically negative correlation.
cues.zh: 真要說的話，數值上甚至是負相關。

cues.en: So particular Montana and what is this one?
cues.zh: 尤其是蒙大拿，以及這個是什麼？

cues.en: Minnesota have uncorrelated decoupled marriage rates and divorce rates.
cues.zh: 明尼蘇達；它們的結婚率與離婚率不相關，彼此脫鉤。

cues.en: Now again, I have no idea how to interpret that, but it is pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 同樣地，我不知道該如何解讀，但很有意思。

cues.en: Also, out of curiosity, I'm going to remove this Bonferroni correction and see what the plot looks like.
cues.zh: 出於好奇，我也要移除 Bonferroni 校正，看看圖會變成怎樣。

cues.en: See, I'm curious how many of these correlations are significant on their own without correcting for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: 我好奇，如果不校正多重比較，有多少相關本身是顯著的。

cues.en: And so a couple more of them turn green, but still some of these are, even when ignoring an appropriate correction for multiple comparisons, these states are still not
cues.zh: 有幾個又變成綠色，但即使忽略適當的多重比較校正，有些州的

cues.en: significantly correlated in terms of the marriage and divorce rates over time.
cues.zh: 結婚率與離婚率隨時間仍沒有顯著相關。

cues.en: Okay, so that was pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 這相當有意思。

cues.en: And then there's another analysis that I wanted to do, which is to determine whether the marriage and divorce rates really are declining over time.
cues.zh: 接著，我還想做另一項分析，判斷結婚率與離婚率是否真的隨時間下降。

cues.en: And I wanted to test that because when you look at these numbers here, certainly visually looks like they're going down, but is that really a significant decline
cues.zh: 我想檢驗這件事，因為看看這些數字，視覺上確實像在下降；但這真的是顯著下降，

cues.en: or is that just my brain's visual system fooling me into thinking that this is a decline?
cues.zh: 還是我的大腦視覺系統誤導我，讓我以為它在下降？

cues.en: So all we can say is qualitatively, it appears that the marriage rates and the divorce rates are going down over time, but we need to do a statistical test.
cues.zh: 我們只能定性地說，結婚率與離婚率似乎隨時間下降，但需要做統計檢定。

cues.en: So I'm gonna do that with a regression.
cues.zh: 所以我要用迴歸來做。

cues.en: This is a simple linear regression where I'm regressing the year onto the marriage rates and then the year onto the divorce rates.
cues.zh: 這是簡單線性迴歸，先用年份對結婚率做迴歸，再用年份對離婚率做迴歸。

cues.en: So I'm using this function fitlm.
cues.zh: 我使用 fitlm 函式。

cues.en: This is something I talked about in the sections on regression and a nova.
cues.zh: 這是迴歸與 ANOVA 章節中談過的內容。

cues.en: Here, I'm normalizing the beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 這裡把 β 係數正規化。

cues.en: This is something I also discussed in the section on multiple regression and extracting the P value so we can do some statistical thresholding.
cues.zh: 這也是多元迴歸章節討論過的內容，並擷取 P 值，以便做統計門檻判斷。

cues.en: Again, I'm using the same P value threshold, Bonferroni corrected threshold that I used for the correlation analysis.
cues.zh: 同樣地，使用與相關分析相同的 P 值門檻，也就是 Bonferroni 校正後的門檻。

cues.en: Okay, so let me run all of this code and then I will explain what kind of plot it generates.
cues.zh: 先執行所有程式，再解釋會產生什麼圖。

cues.en: Okay, so I generated two plots here you can see the x axis corresponds to the state and the Y axis corresponds to the decrease in marriage
cues.zh: 這裡產生兩張圖；X 軸對應州，Y 軸對應每年結婚率

cues.en: or divorce rates per year over time.
cues.zh: 或離婚率隨時間的下降程度。

cues.en: And this is normalized.
cues.zh: 而且，這些值已經正規化。

cues.en: So we can only interpret this relative to the other states.
cues.zh: 因此，只能相對於其他州來解讀。

cues.en: So for each state we have two data values, two slopes, two regression beta coefficients corresponding to the marriage rates.
cues.zh: 每個州都有兩個資料值、兩個斜率、兩個迴歸 β 係數，分別對應結婚率，

cues.en: That's the circles and the divorce rates in these squares.
cues.zh: 也就是圓圈，以及離婚率，也就是方形。

cues.en: So you can see they're almost all negative, which means for almost all states and for marriage and divorce, they actually are going down

cues.en: over time significantly.

cues.en: And here we have, what is this? The District of Columbia.

cues.en: So Washington DC we actually have one exception to the entire country where the marriage rates are actually significantly increasing over time.
cues.zh: 也就是華盛頓特區，全國有一個例外，這裡的結婚率其實隨時間顯著上升。

cues.en: It's a pretty small effect relative to all these other states.
cues.zh: 相對其他州，這個效果很小。

cues.en: It's a pretty small effect, but according to our analysis, it is a statistically significant effect.
cues.zh: 效果很小，但根據我們的分析，它在統計上顯著。

cues.en: Okay, so this plot shows the slopes of marriages and divorce rates over time for all the states.
cues.zh: 這張圖顯示所有州的結婚率與離婚率，隨時間變化的斜率。

cues.en: And then I was curious to know whether the marriage rates were different.
cues.zh: 接著，我好奇結婚率是否不同。

cues.en: So the change in marriage rates over time is different from the change in divorce rates over time.
cues.zh: 也就是結婚率隨時間的變化，是否不同於離婚率隨時間的變化。

cues.en: So what I did was subtract these two coefficients.
cues.zh: 因此，我把這兩個係數相減。

cues.en: You can see that in the code here, I'm just subtracting these two coefficients and I'm storing the difference of the normalized coefficients between the marriage rates
cues.zh: 可以在程式中看到，我只是把這兩個係數相減，儲存結婚率

cues.en: and the divorce rates over time.
cues.zh: 與離婚率隨時間變化的正規化係數之差。

cues.en: So that's plotted here.
cues.zh: 畫在這裡。

cues.en: Now, the positive values are a little bit tricky to interpret in this difference plot because almost all these values are already negative.
cues.zh: 在這張差值圖中，正值有一點難解讀，因為這些數值幾乎本來就是負的。

cues.en: So the way to interpret a positive value here for the slope of marriage minus the slope of divorce is that if these data points are positive, it means
cues.zh: 這裡是結婚斜率減去離婚斜率；如果資料點為正，解讀方式是

cues.en: that marriages and divorces are both decreasing over time.
cues.zh: 結婚率與離婚率都隨時間下降。

cues.en: However, the marriage rates are declining slower than the divorce rates.
cues.zh: 但結婚率下降得比離婚率慢。

cues.zh: 讓我試著換個方式解釋。

cues.en: What positive values on this plot tell us is that over time, fewer people are getting married and fewer people are getting divorced.
cues.zh: 這張圖上的正值告訴我們，隨著時間，結婚的人變少，離婚的人也變少。

cues.en: However, more people are getting married than they are getting divorced.
cues.zh: 不過，結婚的人仍比離婚的人多。

cues.en: So people are staying married and they're less likely to get divorced even though both the marriage rates and the divorce rates are going down.
cues.zh: 因此，人們維持婚姻、比較不容易離婚，即使結婚率與離婚率都在下降。

cues.en: Now when you look at this plot, it's visually obvious that the slopes are negative for the overwhelming majority of cases.
cues.zh: 看這張圖，視覺上顯然絕大多數情況的斜率都是負的。

cues.en: Obviously there's one exception here, but it's obvious that the slopes are all negative.
cues.zh: 這裡明顯有一個例外，但斜率全是負的這件事很明顯。

cues.en: Here, it's not so visually obvious that the difference in slopes is positive 'cause there's quite a lot of negative cases.
cues.zh: 這裡則不太容易一眼看出斜率差是正的，因為有相當多負值。

cues.en: There's quite a lot of states where the divorce rate was actually declining more slowly than the marriage rates.
cues.zh: 有不少州的離婚率，其實下降得比結婚率更慢。

cues.en: So to quantify this, I computed the difference between the beta coefficients for marriage and the beta coefficients for divorce, stored all of those in a vector.
cues.zh: 為了量化，我計算結婚與離婚的 β 係數差，全部儲存成一個向量。

cues.en: And then I ran a T test on those differences and then I put the resulting T and P values into the title of this graph.
cues.zh: 接著對這些差值做 t 檢定，把得到的 t 值與 P 值放進這張圖的標題。

cues.en: So we see that the marriage slope versus the divorce slope is significant.
cues.zh: 所以可以看到，結婚斜率與離婚斜率之間有顯著差異。

cues.en: It's not a huge effect. The T value is 2.1, but with 50 degrees of freedom, because we're doing a one sample T-test on 51 data values, the P value is 0.0396.
cues.zh: 效果不大，t 值是 2.1，但自由度為 50，因為對 51 個資料值做單一樣本 t 檢定，P 值是 0.0396。

cues.en: So it's significant at our threshold of 0.05.
cues.zh: 因此，在 0.05 的門檻下是顯著的。

cues.en: Of course, this is just one test, so we don't need to correct for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: 當然，這只有一個檢定，所以不需要校正多重比較。

cues.en: So it's a moderate effect, but it is significant.
cues.zh: 所以效果中等，但顯著。

cues.en: And again, the interpretation of this is that over time there are fewer people getting married and also fewer people getting divorced.
cues.zh: 同樣地，解讀是，隨著時間，結婚的人變少，離婚的人也變少。

cues.en: However, when you compare marriages to divorces, there are still relatively more marriages than divorces.
cues.zh: 但比較結婚與離婚，結婚仍然相對比離婚多。

cues.en: So fewer people are getting married, but even fewer of them are getting divorced over time.
cues.zh: 所以結婚的人變少，但隨時間離婚的人更少。

cues.zh: 同樣地，我不知道該如何解讀。

cues.en: But this is what the data are telling us.
cues.zh: 但這就是資料告訴我們的事。

cues.en: These are the statistical results.
cues.zh: 這些就是統計結果。
